spearhead.name: Spearhead Doctrine
spearhead.desc: Automated ship designs close to point-blank range, the vanguard pressing a close-quarters attack while the main body provides direct fire support.

battleline.name: Battle Line Doctrine
battleline.desc: Automated ship designs form a battle line for sustained mid-range fire, a flexible all-purpose formation.

barrage.name: Barrage Doctrine
barrage.desc: Automated ship designs stand off to deliver long-range bombardment, with a screen shielding the firing line.

strike_wing.name: Strike Wing Doctrine
strike_wing.desc: Automated ship designs launch strike craft in waves, with a screen guarding the formation.

ambush.name: Ambush Doctrine
ambush.desc: Automated ship designs strike from concealment, leading with a heavy opening salvo backed by long-range fire.

phalanx.name: Phalanx Doctrine
phalanx.desc: Automated ship designs hold a resilient defensive screen backed by supporting fire, prevailing through attrition.
